author: Ayesa Denise Manubag
text:
We are Hiring!

Job Title: Lead Full Stack Python and AI Systems Developer 
Project: PhilRice Corporate Webpage and AI Platform Development 
Contract Duration: 3 months 
Project Location: Remote/On-site Coordination (Philippines) 

We are seeking a Lead Full-Stack Python and AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy the new PhilRice Corporate Webpage and Intelligence Platform. The project follows a 2-phase delivery model. 

Core Technical Requirements (Recommended Stack): 
- Backend Framework: Django 4.x+ with Django REST Framework (DRF) 
- Frontend Framework: React (v18+) with Vite and TypeScript 
- Database: PostgreSQL 12+ (Advanced indexing, JSONB, Full-Text Search) 
- Asynchronous Queues: Redis + Celery Workers 
- AI/ML/RAG Engine: Python, PyTorch, Ollama/vLLM, Transformers, LangChain/LlamaIndex 
- Real-Time Layer: WebSockets (Django Channels/FastAPI ASGI) 
- Deployment Server: Nginx + Gunicorn, Dockerized containerization 
- Compliance: DICT Guidelines, WCAG 2.1 Level AA, Data Privacy Act 2012 

Key Responsibilities: 
- Architect and develop the corporate website using Django and React. 
- Implement role-based authentication, content versioning, media library, and WYSIWYG editor via Django's native admin. 
- Construct secure, Paginated RESTful API endpoints for content consumption and Part AI Integration. 
- Ensure responsive design, SEO optimization, and <3s page load performance. 
- Develop a custom-trained RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) AI Chatbot trained on PhilRice publications, research papers, and farmer resources. 
- Implement multi-language support (English/Filipino) with context-aware session history. 
- Build a real-time, interactive Analytics Dashboard (Pageviews, engagement, search analytics, and AI anomaly detection). 
- Integrate WebSockets for live, word-by-word AI response streaming back to the user browser. 
- Set up automated Celery queues for heavy background tasks (PDF indexing, OCR, vector embedding generation).
